provenance: Original installed G1 firmware executed the included self-authored PPL programs in disposable local profiles. Complete320x240 RGB images are hashed without masking or tolerance. Vendor font bytes and captures remain private. No physical calculator was accessed.

cases.name: joined
cases.source: EXPORT FONTREF() BEGIN LOCAL f; RECT_P(0); FOR f FROM 1 TO 7 DO TEXTOUT_P("AbgXπ√∑∫"+CHAR(57347),10,20+f*26,f,RGB(255,255,255)); END; WAIT(0); RETURN 1; END;

cases.name: isolated
cases.source: EXPORT FONTISOLATED() BEGIN LOCAL f,j,s:="AbgXπ√∑∫"+CHAR(57347); RECT_P(0); FOR f FROM 1 TO 7 DO FOR j FROM 1 TO DIM(s) DO TEXTOUT_P(MID(s,j,1),10+(j-1)*32,20+f*26,f,RGB(255,255,255)); END; END; WAIT(0); RETURN 1; END;

cases.name: layout_color
cases.source: EXPORT FONTLAYOUT() BEGIN LOCAL k,f; RECT_P(0); FOR k FROM 0 TO 3 DO f:=1+2*k; TEXTOUT_P("A"+CHAR(10)+"A",10+80*k,40,f,RGB(255,255,255)); END; RECT_P(0,130,319,239,RGB(239,141,47)); TEXTOUT_P("A",10,150,2,RGB(17,93,201)); WAIT(0); RETURN 1; END;
